prompt:
Goal: Create a clean product reference sheet showing a realistic black tactical carbine-style firearm from multiple angles, like a studio catalog render for a fictional modern weapon. Use black compact tactical carbine as the subject, with no hands, no people, and no environment.

Canvas: Tall vertical white canvas, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, divided into exactly 4 horizontal panels by thin light-gray separator lines. Each panel has a small black Japanese label at the upper left.

Layout: Show exactly 4 views of the same weapon: 1) top panel labeled 右側面, a perfectly horizontal right-side profile facing right; 2) second panel labeled 左側面, a perfectly horizontal left-side profile facing left; 3) third panel labeled 上面, a narrow top-down view running left to right; 4) bottom panel labeled 正面3/4, a larger front three-quarter view with the muzzle on the left and the stock on the right.

Subject details: The weapon is matte black and dark gunmetal with realistic hard-surface modeling, subtle edge highlights, molded polymer body panels, screws, pins, seams, vents, and Picatinny-style rail details. Include exactly 6 major visible components repeated consistently across the views: skeletonized folding-style stock, angled pistol grip, translucent curved magazine, compact optic sight on the top rail, short fore-end with side rails and vent slots, and a cylindrical under-barrel flashlight module. Add small selector markings and tiny red/white decals on the receiver, but keep them mostly illegible.

Visual style: High-resolution realistic product photography mixed with technical reference rendering, neutral studio lighting, sharp focus, crisp silhouettes, black and gray tones, minimal shadows, white background, no dramatic effects.

Constraints: Keep the firearm unloaded-looking and presented only as a static visual object. Do not show ammunition, firing, disassembly, internal mechanisms, measurements, exploded diagrams, or instructions. Use exactly 4 labeled panels and no extra captions, watermarks, logos, or decorative background elements.

promptZh:
目标：创建一张简洁的产品参考图，从多个角度展示一把写实的黑色战术卡宾枪，类似于虚构现代武器的摄影棚目录渲染图。以 black compact tactical carbine 为主体，画面中不包含手、人物或环境。

画布：高垂直白色画布，纵横比约为 2:3，由细浅灰色分隔线分为 4 个水平面板。每个面板左上角均有一个小的黑色日文标签。

布局：展示同一武器的 4 个视图：1）顶部面板，标签为 右側面，展示完全水平的右侧轮廓，朝向右侧；2）第二个面板，标签为 左側面，展示完全水平的左侧轮廓，朝向左侧；3）第三个面板，标签为 上面，展示从左至右的狭窄俯视图；4）底部面板，标签为 正面3/4，展示较大的正面 3/4 视图，枪口朝左，枪托朝右。

主体细节：武器采用哑光黑色和深枪金属色，具有逼真的硬表面建模、微妙的边缘高光、模制聚合物机身面板、螺丝、销钉、接缝、通风口和皮卡汀尼导轨细节。在各视图中保持 6 个主要可见组件的一致性：镂空折叠式枪托、倾斜手枪握把、半透明弧形弹匣、顶部导轨上的紧凑型光学瞄准镜、带有侧导轨和通风槽的短护木，以及圆柱形枪管下方的战术手电筒模块。在机匣上添加小的选择器标记和微小的红/白色贴花，但保持其大部分不可读。

视觉风格：高分辨率写实产品摄影与技术参考渲染相结合，中性摄影棚灯光，焦点清晰，轮廓鲜明，黑灰色调，极简阴影，白色背景，无戏剧性效果。

约束：保持枪械呈现为未装弹状态，仅作为静态视觉对象展示。不要显示弹药、射击、拆解、内部结构、测量数据、爆炸图或说明。使用 4 个带标签的面板，不要添加额外的标题、水印、徽标或装饰性背景元素。
